 Did Harry Styles Just Tell Anna Wintour To 'Go to Bed'? Fans Love Their Cheeky Exchange During Concert
 Fans joke about Wintour's signature bob and the singer's possible future at the Met Gala
By 
 Ryan Tabag 
 Published Oct 23 2026, 7:49 AM BST Share on Twitter 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on WhatsApp 
 One fan comments on Harry Styles: 'Only man alive who can tell Anna Wintour to go to bed and still get invited back next year' 
 @harrystyles/Instagram/Lloyd Wakefield 
 Harry Styles left fans in stitches during his recent Madison Square Garden concert after spotting Anna Wintour in the audience and jokingly telling the former Vogue Editor-in-Chief, 'Go to bed!' The remark prompted playful reactions online, with one fan calling it 'the most specific roast ever' and jokingly asking whether Wintour had slept through the show. The light-hearted jab quickly became one of the night's most talked-about moments. 
 The moment took place during Styles' concert in New York on 21 October 2026. A clip shared online captured the singer addressing Wintour, who was sitting in the audience wearing sunglasses, as other concertgoers sang and danced during the performance. Fans noted that while Wintour was spotted having a great time, another fan video showed the Global Chief Content Officer of Condé Nast watching the performance without moving in her seat, prompting one commenter to describe her signature bob hairstyle: 'That bob has the structural integrity of a concrete bunker. It does not move for mere mortals,' while another commenter added the comment: 'she should've shaked [sic] the bob a little.'
 Harry Styles jokingly tells Anna Wintour to “go to bed” after spotting her at his show in New York City. pic.twitter.com/QAhR52oZQ7 
— Pop Crave (@PopCrave) October 22, 2026

 Fans React as Styles' Banter Meets Fashion Royalty
 After witnessing the moment, fans took to social media to share their reactions. One commenter wrote, 'he's so funny', while another described Styles as 'adorable', praising the singer's humour. One fan offered a more elaborate take on Styles' banter with Wintour, writing, 'telling Anna Wintour to go to bed is the most specific roast ever, did she actually sleep through the set?' A third commenter praised the singer using a popular expression: 'why did he eat.'
 As Vogue's global editorial director, Wintour remains one of fashion's most influential figures and is closely associated with the annual Met Gala. Styles, on the other hand, has also made his mark in fashion. In 2020, he became the first man to appear solo on the cover of American Vogue, wearing a dress for the accompanying photographs. The cover sparked discussions about menswear and gender expression, entrenching him in fashion conversations beyond his music career. Wintour's appearance in the former One Direction member 's concert brought those worlds together. 
 HARRY STYLES ON THE COVER OF VOGUE MAGAZINE. 2020 IS OFFICIALLY SAVED. pic.twitter.com/NXwBd8V3Ya 
— rachel🦋 (@canyonmoonblu) November 13, 2020 
 A Met Gala Invitation in the Making?
 Anna Wintour is the primary chair, organiser, and driving force behind the Met Gala, where guests walk a themed red carpet, preview the Costume Institute's newest exhibition, and attend an exclusive formal dinner and live performance. Some fans quickly turned the exchange into a joke about Harry Styles' future involvement. One commenter suggested Styles was 'definitely getting that Met Gala invite next year'. Another fan imagined Wintour taking the remark as inspiration for a future dress code, joking that Styles should wear a pyjama suit to next year's event.
 It must be noted, however, that the comments are just mere playful speculation, and not evidence that Styles had received an actual invitation to the annual high-fashion fundraising event. But for fans, Styles' cheeky 'Go to bed!' has given them a memorable concert moment — and left people joking on social media about whether the singer has just talked himself into a Met Gala invitation.
